model_name_source: AT-1000S is printed in the supplied official video; the product webpage uses ALLTURN FORKMAN.
source_status: Official marketing example specifications, not an OEM engineering drawing or a verified configuration sheet.
user_selected_scope: FORKMAN-inspired virtual AGV with the existing automation, 2026-11-18
application: New articulated appearance selected for active vehicles. Existing tested dimensions, mass, tyres, motor model, hydraulic model and automation remain simulator assumptions; the published examples below are not applied or presented as measured values.
source_disclaimer_ko: 안내된 사양은 예시이며, 실제 모델 사양은 변경되거나 상이할 수 있습니다.

published_example.drive: four independently driven mecanum wheels with 45-degree passive rollers
published_example.base_control: wireless remote, AGV expansion described separately

unknown_or_conflicting: own weight, component mass, centre of mass and inertia
engineering dimensions and whether stated length includes forks
fork length: webpage example is 1100mm; supplied video specification slide appears to show 1200mm
tyre width, track, roller count, load rating basis and friction curve
motor torque-speed curves, gear ratio, brake and efficiency
hydraulic circuit, bore, pressure, pump displacement and cylinder stroke
capacity derating with height/load centre and permitted elevated travel
exact sensor hardware and completed autonomous navigation configuration
OEM CAD and mast tilt mechanism dimensions

observed_video_samples.method: Official YouTube storyboard samples at 2-second intervals. No UI automation, full playback or frame-based performance measurement.
observations: Real orange wedge-shaped chassis, four-wheel layout and a black lifting mast are visible.
A human operates a wireless remote; this does not establish autonomous navigation.
Rack handling and comparative manoeuvring are shown; edited/speeded footage is not a calibration trace.
AT-1000S model name and specification slides are visible.
The closing sequence also advertises LIFTMAN; that lifting platform must not be confused with the forklift.

fit_assessment.appropriate_scope: A FORKMAN-inspired virtual AGV using the project's own automation, with source examples and simulator assumptions separated.
